clips.title: The story
paras: At Lake Falathim, Raene's Cleansing turns from a search for Teronis into a grim recovery. Raene Wolfrunner sent the night elf sentinel there, and now you must bring back his journal and a glowing gem held by the murlocs before reporting to her in Astranaar.

Raene Wolfrunner sent you to Lake Falathim to find Teronis, a night elf sentinel. You find him dead beside the water. His belongings include an intact journal, with an account of his assignment and what he found about Ashenvale's strange disturbances.
Teronis tracked a rare, glowing stone to Lake Falathim, but the lake's aggressive murlocs now hold it. You need to recover the gem and Teronis' journal to continue the work he began.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As you rummage through Teronis' belongings, you find a journal that is still in good condition.
You take the journal and leave Teronis' corpse as is.
The only thing left to do is find the gem Teronis was seeking. Raene mentioned it being in the area. Perhaps the murlocs have it...

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is terrible, friend. Teronis is dead?!
The time for mourning will come, but for now we must focus our efforts. I shall send some of the Sentinels to recover Teronis' body as soon as possible.
You have Teronis' journal and the gem he was seeking. Do you think you're capable of completing his task? I would rest much better knowing his death was not in vain.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
